claim_boundary: Ten national-division teenage fencers completed graded cycling tests. These are participant-grouped physiological observations, not fencing bouts, weapon labels, clinical diagnoses, training effects, or a representative athlete population. Exact age and source IDs are removed; sensitive row tables remain local.
line_count_note: The PhysioNet page describes 52,063 lines; the CSV contains 52,062 data rows plus one header line.
repository_policy: privacy-minimized row tables local; code and aggregates public
vo2_unit_note: The source documentation says mL/min, while deposited values are approximately 0.07-3.46 and may represent L/min; the field is retained as vo2_source_units without silently converting it.
